# ghapi

> GitHub API 全操作を Python から型安全・直感的に呼び出せる完全クライアント。開発者向けに認証・ページネーション・GitHub Actions 連携・GraphQL サポートをワンパッケージで提供する。

## Guide

- [GhApi details](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/ghapi/blob/main/00_core.ipynb): Detailed information on the GhApi API
- [GitHub Actions details](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/ghapi/blob/main/01_actions.ipynb): Functionality for helping to create GitHub Actions workflows in Python
- [Authentication](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/ghapi/blob/main/02_auth.ipynb): Helpers for creating GitHub API tokens
- [Pagination](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/ghapi/blob/main/03_page.ipynb): Parallel and serial pagination
- [The events API](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/ghapi/blob/main/04_event.ipynb): Helpers for getting GitHub API events
- [graphql](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/ghapi/blob/main/05_graphql.ipynb): GitHub GraphQL API support for ghapi
- [Command line interface](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/ghapi/blob/main/10_cli.ipynb): Access to the GitHub API from the command line
- [Full GitHub API reference](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/ghapi/blob/main/50_fullapi.ipynb): All operations available through the GitHub API
- [Internal - OpenAPI Parser](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/ghapi/blob/main/90_build_lib.ipynb): This library leverages the OpenAPI Specification to create a python client for the GitHub API.
- [ Create Examples](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/ghapi/blob/main/examples/_create_examples.ipynb)
- [ghapi](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/ghapi/blob/main/index.ipynb): A delightful and complete interface to GitHub's amazing API
- [Getting started with GitHub Actions](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/ghapi/blob/main/tutorials/tutorial_actions.ipynb): GitHub Actions help you automate tasks within your software development life cycle.

## Optional

- [Release notes](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/ghapi/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): - Only decode non binary types (#206)
- [How to contribute](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/ghapi/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Before anything else, please install the git hooks that run automatic scripts during each commit and merge to strip the notebooks of superfluous metadata (and avoid merge conflicts).
